entities.summary: Claridade Literary Movement, a transformative movement in Cabo Verde (1936–1960). Emerged from Abolition of Slavery in Cabo Verde and Mindelo Coaling Station. Catalyzed PAIGC Founded (Cabo Verde Wing).
